tools.name: search
tools.description: Search pixelworkers.org: guides (the Codex), field notes, services and case studies. Returns matching pages with an id, title, URL and summary. Use fetch with an id for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text of one pixelworkers.org page, by the id from search (or its pixelworkers.org URL).

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: What Pixelworkers does: each service with a one-line summary and its page. Prices are not listed; every job gets a fixed, itemized quote through start_a_quote.

tools.name: start_a_quote
tools.description: For someone who wants Pixelworkers to do a job. Returns a link to pixelworkers.org that opens the quote chat with the job already typed in; they send it and get a fixed, scoped price in minutes. Nothing is submitted from here.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, start_a_quote · Public sink: start_a_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, start_a_quote · Public sink: start_a_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
